decisions.decision: License is decision-support only, not a safety gate: every third-party skill needs a mandatory, license-independent content security review (automated scan + security-reviewer verdict) and NO auto-adopt without explicit human sign-off (TASK-122). Graph: task-122 produced-by decision-20260708-license-not-safety-content-review-gate.
decisions.rationale: TASK-120 UAT surfaced that a self-declared frontmatter license is forgeable and license classification says nothing about prompt-injection or malicious content. The reviewer verdict is an injected input to the LLM/network-free assimilate module; the orchestrator spawns the real security-reviewer subagent at runtime, keeping the module unit-testable while the human stays the gate.
